questions.prompt: Appearance — How will I maintain a neat, appropriate and professional appearance?
Hygiene — What daily hygiene and sanitation habits will I consistently practise?
Client privacy — How will I protect client information, conversations and dignity?
Therapeutic boundaries — How will I maintain professional boundaries, respect consent and handle inappropriate requests?
Punctuality — What habits will help me become more dependable and prepared?
Courtesy — How will I demonstrate respect in my words, tone and actions?
My personal pledge: In two or three sentences, describe the therapist you intend to become.

title: WHAT SHOULD A CLIENT FEEL AFTER INTERACTING WITH ME?

questions.prompt: How do I want clients to describe my professionalism?
Does my tone of voice contribute to relaxation or discomfort?
Do I make clients feel respected regardless of their personality or background?
Do I listen to clients' concerns and preferences?
Do I maintain my standards even when I am tired or having a difficult day?
What is one aspect of my service that I would like to improve before resumption?
What must I preserve? Identify the professional strengths and good habits you already possess.
What must I improve? Identify the behaviours, attitudes, or routines that require attention.
What must I begin? Identify new habits that will help you deliver a more consistent and professional experience.
